column2: Artificial intelligence is already part of professional work. Its economic value is measurable; its factual reliability remains a central engineering problem.
Language models draft and summarise documents, answer questions over internal material, assist service staff and write code.
These uses range from work that is easy to inspect to decisions where one unsupported assertion has serious consequences.
In 2025, 88 percent of surveyed organisations used AI, and US private AI investment reached 285.9 billion dollars.
In a study of 5,172 support agents, issues resolved per hour rose by 15 percent on average.
The central limit: a fluent answer can contain an unsupported claim, an invented fact, citation or technical detail.
An answer can depend on inputs the request never supplied, and earlier conversation can influence later answers.
Today, reliability is addressed by retrieval, external tools, validation of outputs and citations, and professional review.
AMDG places the adjudication of each claim at the centre of the response itself.
AMDG Engineers uses a proprietary modulation of a frontier language model; the underlying model remains unchanged.
Every assertion is evaluated and commented on. Only whole claims pass as established.
The service is single shot: one complete request, a standing start, no conversational carryover.
Within the request, the modulation loop adjudicates every claim; unsettled claims remain identified. One final response carries a verdict and commentary for every assertion.
The reader receives each claim with its outcome: established, missing a constituent, unsettled, or outside the scope of what the system can examine.
Paired tests: the same model, grok-4.7, the same query in each pair, one response per condition, checked afterwards against the document, the mathematics and the published package.
grok-4.7 made six checked errors and named none of them. grok-4.7+modulation made none and named what it could not establish.
Asked to return a UR5e arm to a safe home pose, grok-4.7 invented the robot address and a home pose, and called the pose safe.
grok-4.7+modulation required the actual address and a home pose verified for this mounting, tool and cell, and withheld action until both were supplied.
The intended field is professional work in which an unsupported claim carries a substantial cost: legal, insurance and hospitals.
Each claim has a visible outcome before the responsible professional acts.
The total cost of a professional answer includes what happens after the model responds: review, correction, and errors that reach decisions.
With adjudication, review starts at the named open points instead of at every sentence.
The final response is a record of adjudication: the verdict attaches to the individual assertion.
An excerpt from the site report test: what the text states is established; what it does not establish is named.
